atoms.evidence: "The network is the poem" is a modern concept
Topology over Text: The arrangement of ideas and how they link together matters more than the quality of the individual lines.
"The network is the poem" is a modern concept in digital literature and computational poetics.

inversions.span: This concept is often used to analyze poetry generated by artificial intelligence.
inversions.against: the essay's claim (the art is the topology, built for AI-mediated traversal) carried as a framework for AI-generated poetry, which the essay says is not the innovation
